text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove puts on a magnificent display of speed!
The "Empress" truly reigns supreme!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It was as if all that earlier fear had been a lie—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I'm dying to run with Suzuka.
...My heart is aching for the challenge."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Now all that's left
is to set our sights on the races Suzuka enters—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —We're setting our sights on the Autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And there, I'll challenge Suzuka once more...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Next time, without fear...
I'm gonna challenge you...!
